live_test: returnCountOnly=true against the real query gave 2,227 matching rows since 2024-09-01; a resultRecordCount=1000 page returned exceededTransferLimit=true with 1,000 rows (e.g. CB-DIRECT BONDS RANCH LP, 302 units); confirms this layer genuinely needs resultOffset paging past row 1,000 -- added generic ArcGIS pagination to find_upcoming._fetch_rows (loops on exceededTransferLimit, capped at 20 pages) rather than a one-off Fort-Worth-specific fetch wrapper, since it's a shared shape any large TX/AZ layer could hit.
notes: Units is a text field on this layer (values like '1', '0', '302' were seen as plain digit strings, not free text like '212 units', but units_text_pattern '(\\d+)' still matches either shape safely). Full_Street_Address is null on EVERY row of this layer -- the real address lives in Addr_No/Direction/Street_Name/Street_Suffix/Street_Suffix_Dir, now mapped as address_parts. B1_SPECIAL_TEXT is the real project name (e.g. 'Alexan Copper Ranch', 'Hughes House Phase 2'), mapped as fields.name; without it every row fell back to Specific_Use ('Apartment') and was nameless. Owner_Full_Name is a real owner field. Plan-review submittals with no sited address are filed at '<submittal no> FOR REVIEW ONLY WAY' and are dropped as placeholder addresses. Audited 2026-09-20, see propertystack/runs/2026-09-20-fort-worth-audit.md.
